correctness.rationale: Primitive-period and constant-block argument force all symbol cycles to have common order. Free quotient Euler-tour lifting computes all-monodromy; for n>=3 it vanishes because q outgoing edge voltages at each source agree, whereas for n=2 it is a generator exactly for d=2 with odd m. The BEST and directed matrix-tree enumeration yields the exact count; independent full small-alphabet de Bruijn enumeration and quotient Euler-tour DP match. For n=1 the cyclic orbit count is explicit. Exact finite computations are supporting checks only.

value.rationale: An exact complete classification across all q, all n and all nonidentity alphabet permutations resolves a natural symmetry-constrained universal-cycle problem. Voltage obstruction reveals the sharp impossibility above order two and produces an explicit count in all surviving order-two cases (q=2 mod 4). It is substantively more than the familiar binary example or a routine parameter substitution and enables exact design enumeration.
